label: a cook or maid in her working dress, 1900s
note: Gathered 2026-11-06 for T-3423, the first woman of the plan 'Photographic humans: the path'. Three C. L. Wasson studio stereographs of 1903 (a comic series set in a kitchen; LOC, no known restrictions). None is of Chicago, the Glessner household or Martha Williamson: a reference set says what a woman in this role and decade looked like, never who the subject was. The prints are monochrome and say nothing about colour.

pictures.name: wasson_1903_shirtwaist_near
pictures.from: master TIFF 1s44451u.tif (5881 x 3050), crop [900, 640, 1800, 2700] of the card's left frame, reduced to 699 x 1600
pictures.caption: A young woman in shirtwaist and bib apron at a kitchen table, facing the camera at a few metres. C. L. Wasson stereograph, 1903 (LOC 2022631776)
pictures.shows: Full length, facing the camera at about three metres: a pale shirtwaist with a white standing collar and a dark tie, sleeves pushed up; a dotted bib apron with ruffled edges over the chest and skirt front; a dark flounced skirt to the floor; low heeled shoes; hair swept up full round the face to a knot.

pictures.name: wasson_1903_maid_near
pictures.from: master TIFF 1s44466u.tif (5843 x 3012), crop [760, 640, 1620, 2700] of the card's left frame, reduced to 668 x 1600
pictures.caption: The same woman from her left front, holding up a pie, at a few metres. C. L. Wasson stereograph, 1903 (LOC 2022631791)
pictures.shows: Three-quarter from the front left at about three metres: the shirtwaist's full shoulder and pushed-up sleeve, the bib apron's ruffled strap over the shoulder and its skirt falling below the knee, the long dark skirt behind, hair drawn up to a knot on the crown with a small white cap.

pictures.name: wasson_1903_cook_near
pictures.from: master TIFF 1s44450u.tif (5881 x 3050), crop [860, 300, 1960, 2560] of the card's left frame, reduced to 779 x 1600
pictures.caption: An older cook at the kitchen table, facing the camera at a few metres. C. L. Wasson stereograph, 1903 (LOC 2022631775)
pictures.shows: Facing the camera at about three metres: a dark long-sleeved blouse with a pale trimmed yoke, a checked bib apron, a dark spotted skirt to the floor, a cloth bound over the hair: a second working dress of the decade.

pictures.name: wasson_1903_maid_frame
pictures.from: master TIFF 1s44466u.tif (5843 x 3012), the card's left frame [520, 150, 2910, 2720], reduced to 1488 x 1600
pictures.caption: The whole kitchen frame: the woman at the table and a man in the doorway. C. L. Wasson stereograph, 1903 (LOC 2022631791)
pictures.shows: The whole frame, the figures small in it: how a pale shirtwaist, a white apron and a dark skirt read as three bands of tone on a standing woman, against a man in dark evening dress.

pictures.name: wasson_1903_cook_frame
pictures.from: master TIFF 1s44450u.tif (5881 x 3050), the card's left frame [500, 150, 2920, 2720], reduced to 1507 x 1600
pictures.caption: The whole kitchen frame with the older cook at the table. C. L. Wasson stereograph, 1903 (LOC 2022631775)
pictures.shows: The whole frame: a dark-dressed cook with a pale apron and a cloth over her hair, the floor-length skirt reaching the floor all round, read small.
